NAV S$10,383,003 · watcher +0.006% (flat; Sep 18 restated up ~S$15.8k, standing quirk) · listed flag +0.035% · zero riskFlags

  • Biggest mover: silver. Spot +3.02% to $67.18 (USAGOLD), leading metals for a second post-FOMC session; gold $4,368.60 +0.60%, ratio ~65. In-book: SMIC HK$65.15 +4.41% led (HSTech +2.2%); SILJ $30.19 +0.30%, SLVP $38.63 +0.49%, GDX $94.45 −1.53%. Downside outlier: Tencent HK$419.00 −1.64%, closed at the day low through the 425.60 support.
  • The one thing: both event risks resolved in your favor — BOJ hiked +25bp to 1.25% (7–2) and the yen weakened (no carry stress; Nikkei +1.4%; rate check pulled yen back to upper-156s); quad witching passed quietly. Now the main event: Xi visits the US this week — He Lifeng talks through Sep 23, LNG tariff cut on the table (Reuters), ~$30bn reciprocal relief — against the newly signed Russia-Iran Act whose 100% buyer duties technically cover China.

Risk flags — none

  • riskFlags empty — first clean sheet; Friday's MYR watch did not recur
  • L46.SI Yahoo feed 404, 7th session — line effectively unpriced

Position moves (verified Friday closes)

  • US ETFs: SILJ $30.19 +0.30% · SLVP $38.63 +0.49% · GDX $94.45 −1.53%
  • HK: SMIC HK$65.15 +4.41% · Tencent HK$419.00 −1.64% · Xiaomi HK$26.40 +0.99% · HSI 24,750.78 +0.6%
  • SGX: STI 5,656.11 −0.08% · DBS S$76.86 −0.10%
  • Asia: Nikkei +1.4% (post-BOJ) · KOSPI +2.7% (SK Hynix +6%) · SSE +0.9%
  • US Fri: S&P 7,650.50 +0.17% · Nasdaq +0.39% · Dow −0.18% (worst week since March) · 10y 4.995% · VIX ~15.5 · WTI ~$100.7 · CNH 6.6930 (4-yr high)

Insider trades (7 days)

  • Wing Tai (W05.SI): director-dealing filings ran Sep 10–17 (six straight business days), then paused — nothing Sep 18 or the weekend. Sep 14 Form 1 names Chairman & MD Cheng Wai Keung (share counts in PDF, not machine-verified). SGX filing (Sep 14) · Wing Tai IR
  • HK: no director dealings found for Tencent/SMIC/Xiaomi; Tencent issuer buyback continues ~HK$100m/day (context, not insider dealing). None found for other held SGX names.

Congress trades (filings Sep 16–18; nothing over the weekend)

  • FL-18 Rep (filed 9/18): defensive rotation — sold JPM/GOOG×2/AAPL, bought MCD/NVO/PEP×2/ACN×2 + LSYIX short-duration HY bond fund, all $1K–$15K
  • OH-2 Rep (filed 9/18): PG buy $1K–$15K
  • FL-19 Rep (filed 9/16): HWM sell ×2, PH sell ×2, NFLX buy ×2 ($1K–$15K each)
  • Nothing in your tickers. NJ-5's two-sided MSFT options block (9/15) aged out of the 5-day window but remains the fortnight's largest flow. Unusual Whales

Trump / policy watch (weekend + 48h)

  • Xi visits the US this week — the main event; He Lifeng delegation in Washington through Sep 23; US-China discussing LNG tariff cut (Reuters); ~$30bn reciprocal relief; Citi's Fraser at the state dinner. Counter-signal: Moolenaar letter urging tighter AI chip controls
  • Trump signed the Russia-Iran sanctions Act Friday (H.R. 5334, Lindsey O. Graham Act): up to 100% duties on top-5 Russian-energy buyers (China/India exposed), 500% on Russian goods, Iran Sanctions Act +5 years
  • Iran/Hormuz: IRGC hit tanker Trend Friday; Trump talking to Houthis ("they want a deal"); Bab el-Mandeb effectively closed (transits −88%); Saudi E-W pipeline shut; SK rejected troops request
  • Greenland: US-Denmark deal — US "permanent control" of security + veto on adversary investment (Arctic minerals angle)
  • CNY: strongest PBOC fixing since Feb 2023 (6.7521), 8th straight day; offshore CNH touched 6.6930 (4-yr high)
  • Grid/AI: 12 data-center proposals on 17,600 acres of public land (WaPo); Schmid: inflation trending above 3%; Buffett handed Berkshire chair to Howard Friday
  • Newsquawk, Sep 18 · Kyiv Independent

Alpha — signals, not advice (~62% cash undeployed)

  • Silver/miners 20% vs ~4%: thesis validated twice — $62–64 held through FOMC, BOJ passed cleanly, spot $67.18 (+3.02%), ratio ~65; add condition fully met; 10y at 5% is the swing factor — tranches, not blocks; leveraged line equity now ~S$96k
  • HK AI (Asia 10% vs ~3%, AI 15% vs ~1%): summit week = max de-escalation window; tape already picked its leader (SMIC +4.41%, semis strongest) while Tencent broke support — but Tencent buys back ~HK$100m/day; reclaim of ~439 (SMA20) is the confirmation tell; Moolenaar letter is the headline risk
  • Defense 15% vs ~0%: Russia-Iran Act signed, dual chokepoint closure, Greenland deal, allies pressed; 10y at 4.995% = squarely in the planned duration/TIPS entry zone; tranche-build trigger live, stage it against Trump's rate campaign

trumpWatch.title: Xi visits the US this week — the main event
trumpWatch.detail: Newsquawk Week in Focus (Sep 21-25) leads with Xi's US visit. He Lifeng's delegation is in Washington through Sep 23 working the May Beijing summit measures; Reuters: US-China discussing a cut to the tariff on US LNG; ~$30bn reciprocal tariff relief under discussion; Citi CEO Fraser expected at the state dinner. Counter-signal: House China Panel chair Moolenaar urged Trump to tighten AI chip export controls ('PRC not a long term market for American AI').

trumpWatch.title: Trump signed the Russia-Iran sanctions Act into law Friday
trumpWatch.detail: H.R. 5334 — the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026: within 30 days, duties up to 100% on goods from top-5 buyers of Russian crude/gas (China and India exposed by design) and up to 500% on Russian goods; Iran Sanctions Act extended five years; presidential waiver with national-interest certification. House 262-159, Senate 86-11. Zelensky welcomed the signing.

trumpWatch.title: BOJ hiked +25bp to 1.25% (7-2) — yen weakened, no carry stress
trumpWatch.detail: Highest since 1995; dissenters Asada and Sato (Takaichi reflationist appointees) wanted a HOLD; prior hawk Takata joined the majority. Japan Aug CPI 1.9% headline / 1.7% ex-fresh-food. Ueda: 'the stage for setting policy has changed.' Yen fell ~1% to 157.9, then a BOJ rate check lifted it to upper-156s. Nikkei +1.4%. Effective Sep 24.

trumpWatch.title: Iran/Hormuz: tanker hit; Trump talking to Houthis; Bab el-Mandeb shut
trumpWatch.detail: IRGC hit the Togo-flagged tanker Trend in Hormuz Friday. Trump: US is talking to the Houthis ('they want a deal'); 'we'll see' on whether to annihilate Iran. Houthis have effectively closed Bab el-Mandeb (transits -88% to ~4 ships/day; tanker traffic -91%); Saudi East-West pipeline remains shut; Saudi delegation met Mossad on Houthi ops; South Korea publicly rejected Trump's troop request.

trumpWatch.title: US-Denmark Greenland deal: 'permanent control' of security for the US
trumpWatch.detail: Trump announced the deal Saturday; Danish PM Frederiksen confirmed. Large US military presence; Trump asserts no US adversary may invest in Greenland without US approval — explicit Arctic minerals/rare-earths angle after months of threats to seize the territory.

trumpWatch.title: CNY at 4-year high into summit week; grid/AI and misc tape
trumpWatch.detail: PBOC set the strongest fixing since Feb 2023 (6.7521, 8th straight daily strengthening); offshore CNH touched 6.6930. Elsewhere: 12 data-center proposals on 17,600 acres of public land across six states (WaPo); Fed's Schmid: supported the hike, 'inflation trending above 3%'; CME FedWatch into Dec: 47% one more 25bp, 42% 50bp; Buffett handed the Berkshire chair to Howard Friday; Russia began Duma elections and seized Auchan/Nestle assets.

opportunities.thesis: Real assets 20% vs ~4%. Thesis validated twice: $62-64 held through the unanimous hawkish FOMC, then the BOJ passed cleanly Friday (yen fell, no carry unwind) and spot printed $67.18 (+3.02%) with the gold-silver ratio at ~65, tightest of the week. Structure underneath: 6th straight physical deficit, PBOC adding gold 22 consecutive months, coin/bar premiums firm through the washout.
opportunities.signal: Add condition fully met. Swing factor is the 10y back at 4.995% — scale in tranches, not blocks; spec longs 73rd percentile argues modest sizing. Leveraged IBKR line equity ~S$96k after the bounce — ride it, no urgency either way.

The tape has picked its leader: SMIC +4.41% Friday with semis the strongest HK sector (HSTech +2.2%, SK Hynix +6%), while Tencent broke 425.60 support to 419 — though the issuer itself buys back ~HK$100m/day under the weakness.

The 10y sits at 4.995% — squarely in the planned entry zone.
